modules.title: Introduction to Owe I (Proverbs)
modules.html:
Common Yoruba proverbs and their meanings. This section covers introduction to owe i (proverbs).

Key points

  • Owe: 'Bí omọdé bá dé ibi ẹ̀rù, yóò _____'. — Sá.
  • Owe: 'Ti ilé bá tòrò, ọmọ _____ ni ẹni tí ó da a ru'. — Àlè.

Worked examples

Q: Owe: 'Bí omọdé bá dé ibi ẹ̀rù, yóò _____'.
A: Sá — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sá.

Q: Owe: 'Ti ilé bá tòrò, ọmọ _____ ni ẹni tí ó da a ru'.
A: Àlè — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Àlè.

More key points

  • Owe: 'Bí omọdé bá dé ibi ẹ̀rù, yóò _____'. — Sá.
  • Owe: 'Ti ilé bá tòrò, ọmọ _____ ni ẹni tí ó da a ru'. — Àlè.

quiz.q: Owe: 'Bí omọdé bá dé ibi ẹ̀rù, yóò _____'.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sá.

quiz.q: Owe: 'Ti ilé bá tòrò, ọmọ _____ ni ẹni tí ó da a ru'.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Àlè.

quiz.q: Kí ni 'Ọmọ-olórí-ire' nínú àṣà Yorùbá?
options: Ọmọ tí ó ní owó lọ́wọ́
quiz.solution: An 'olórí-ire' is someone believed to have chosen a good 'Ori' (destiny/inner head) before coming to earth.

quiz.q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Syllable'?
quiz.solution: Yoruba language uses 'Sílẹ́bù' for Syllable.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ó jẹ́ orúkọ-àbíkú?
quiz.solution: Names like 'Banjoko' (Stay with us) are given to Abiku children to encourage them to stay alive.

quiz.q: Ta ni ó mọ 'Orí' ní Ìmọ̀-ìṣẹ̀dá Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Ajalamopin is the potter in heaven who creates the inner heads (Ori).

quiz.q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe ọ̀rọ̀-asopọ̀?
quiz.solution: 'Èmi' is a pronoun, while the others are conjunctions.

quiz.q: Èwo ni oúnjẹ àgbàdo?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Èkọ/Ogi.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Ojú ń ro mí'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Mo ń jìyà/Mo ń ṣiṣẹ́.

quiz.q: Olùwà nínú gbolohun ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Subject.

quiz.q: Ṣàngó ń lo:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: Iná.

quiz.q: Kọ́ńsónáǹtì:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2024). Correct answer: b, d, f, g....

quiz.q: Ta ni òrìṣà tí ó ní ẹ̀tọ́ lórí àrá àti mọ̀nàmọ́ná?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ṣàngó.

quiz.q: Orúkọ wo ni a ń pe ọmọ tí a bí pẹ̀lú kòtò lẹ́yìn etí?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Ìgè.

quiz.q: Fáwẹ́lì wo ni kò sí nínú èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: c, q, v, z.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Àbúrò'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Younger sibling.

quiz.q: Iru ounjẹ wo ni a mọ àwọn Ìjẹ̀bú mọ́?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Ìkọkọrẹ.

quiz.q: Fawẹ́lì mélòó ni ó wà nínú èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Méjìlá.

quiz.q: Kí ni a máa ń pè ní 'Gírámà' ní èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ìlànà-èdè.

quiz.q: Èwo nínú wọ̀nyí ni lítíréṣọ̀ àtẹnudẹ́nu?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Oríkì.

quiz.q: Ìtumọ̀ òwe yìí: 'Ilé ayé kúrú' ni...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Life is short.

quiz.q: Àmì ohùn (Tones) mélòó ló wà ní èdè Yorùbá?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Mẹ́ta.

quiz.q: Kí ni ìtúmọ̀ òwe 'Ilé là á wò kí á tó sọ ọmọ lórúkọ'?
options: We look at the house before naming
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Consider background before naming.

quiz.q: Ilà wo ni a ń kọ sí ojú?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ilà-Ojú.

quiz.q: Ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ń so ọ̀rọ̀ méjì pọ̀ ni:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ọ̀rọ̀-Aṣèpọ̀.

Kí ni 'Ọmọ-olórí-ire' nínú àṣà Yorùbá — Ọmọ tí àyànmọ́ rẹ̀ dára.
quiz.solution: Kí ni 'Ọmọ-olórí-ire' nínú àṣà Yorùbá — Ọmọ tí àyànmọ́ rẹ̀ dára.

quiz.q: About 'syllable', which of the following is true in Owe I (Proverbs)?
options: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Syllable' — Sílẹ́bù.
Kí ni 'Èmi' ń jẹ́ nínú gbólóhùn yìí: 'Èmi ni alága' — Olùwà.
quiz.solution: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Syllable' — Sílẹ́bù.

quiz.q: About 'njo', which of the following is true in Owe I (Proverbs)?
options: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ó jẹ́ orúkọ-àbíkú — Bánjókòó.
Kí ni 'Èmi' ń jẹ́ nínú gbólóhùn yìí: 'Èmi ni alága' — Olùwà.
quiz.solution: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ó jẹ́ orúkọ-àbíkú — Bánjókòó.
